lines.text: David cries out for God to save him because the waters are up to his neck, and his throat is parched.
David's haters outnumber the hairs of his head, and he has become a stranger to his brothers because of zeal for God's house.
David wept and fasted and wore sackcloth, and the people at the gate honored him for it.

wrong_details.wrong: the people at the gate honored him
wrong_details.true: it brought him reproach, and those who sit at the gate mock him

lines.text: David asks God to answer quickly and rescue him from the mire, but he finds comforters in his brothers.

wrong_details.wrong: he finds comforters in his brothers
wrong_details.true: he looked for comforters but found no one

lines.text: David will praise God's name in song, and God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah.
